title: The kb-ingest section command escapes backticks and does not parse under PowerShell
goal: selfdoc.py section ignores backticks when it compares headings, and kb-ingest/SKILL.md names the plugin section without backticks, so its command runs the same under Bash and PowerShell

run: import subprocess,sys; r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/selfdoc.py','section','plugin',"6. A team's own knowledge: roots beside kb/public"],capture_output=True,text=True); t=open('.claude/skills/kb-ingest/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read(); sys.exit(0 if r.returncode==0 and chr(92)+chr(96) not in t else 1)
